Pink Ryder Air Rifle
Damage Type:  Slashing
Wielding:  Two-Handed Ranged
Attack Speed:  Fast
Client weapon speed:  105
Client damage coeff:  0.49

Pink Ryder Air Rifle is listed on the Two-Handed-ranger weapon list. Stats on this page come from that list and the Dungeon Runners client files.

The client also has material-tier versions of this weapon (Cardboard Pink Ryder Air Rifle, Celestial Pink Ryder Air Rifle, Diamond Pink Ryder Air Rifle, Iron Pink Ryder Air Rifle, Obsidian Pink Ryder Air Rifle, Stone Pink Ryder Air Rifle, Tin Pink Ryder Air Rifle, Titanium Pink Ryder Air Rifle, …).
